MissionLog.title: Mission Log
MissionLog.description: Saved telemetry snapshot and simulation state from JWST spacecraft and Cosmic Canvas.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the mission log author.

targetName.description: Name of the target object or orbital region.

targetId.description: Unique identifier of target celestial body.

timestampMs.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds of the simulation state.

telemetry.description: Telemetry parameters including distance, orbital speed, mirror temperature, and orientation.

notes.description: User observatory notes or research commentary.

/mission_logs/{logId}.description: Collection of telemetry snapshots and observatory logs saved by users.
